name: update_bulk_redirect_version
description:
Manage a project's bulk redirect version by ID. Each call selects one of the three fixed action values in the input schema: promote publishes a staged version to production; restore republishes a previous production version; discard deletes a staged version without changing production. Promote and restore change live redirect rules.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/bulk-redirects/versions --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
